name: Door of Destinies
oracle_text:
As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
Whenever you cast a spell of the chosen type, put a charge counter on this artifact.
Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact.
blocked_sentences: Creatures you control of the chosen type get +1/+1 for each charge counter on this artifact.

needs.what: A leaf in the *static* value language that reads a counter count off the static's own source, so a `buff` (or `set_pt`) static's `power`/`toughness` can be "for each <kind> counter on this permanent" -- i.e. allow `{"counters_on": {"counter": "charge", "objects": {"self_only": true}}}` (or an equivalent source-scoped `counters` value form) wherever `{"const": n}` is legal inside a static ability, and let the anthem's magnitude be recomputed as counters are added and removed
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The buff has to be a static ability, because it must apply continuously to whatever creatures of the chosen type are on the battlefield at any moment, including ones that arrive after the counters do -- so no op will do: `pump` is until-end-of-turn, and `add_counters` putting +1/+1 counters onto the creatures themselves is a different card (it would not scale existing creatures when a later charge counter arrives, and would not size up creatures cast afterwards). But the static value language is deliberately narrower than `value_keys`: `_validate_static_value` in src/automtg/cards/loader.py permits only `const`, `count`, `mana_symbols`, `min_life_of` and `max_life_of`, and `_static_value` in src/automtg/engine/characteristics.py returns 0 for anything else -- so the `counters_on` leaf that exists in the effect-side value language is rejected at load time here, and there is no way to reach a counter count from inside a static's magnitude. `count` cannot substitute: it counts *objects* matching a filter, and counters are not objects, so no `static_filter_keys` combination can express "the number of charge counters on this artifact". The `counters` head in `static_condition_keys` proves counters on the source are already a safe pipeline input for a static to read -- but it is a boolean threshold test (`_condition_met` compares the count against a fixed amount and yields on/off), so it can only switch a fixed-size anthem on and off, never scale one. Emulating unbounded scaling with a ladder of counter-threshold-conditioned +1/+1 statics is both unbounded and a different card, and each such static's `text` would be a sentence the card does not print, which the residual gate reads. Scope note: the card's other two lines need nothing new -- `choose_type` on a `self_enters` trigger, and a `spell_cast` trigger filtered by `{"subtypes": [{"chosen_type_of": "self"}]}` running `add_counters` with a `charge` kind on `self_only`, the same shapes Vanquisher's Banner already uses. Only the scaling anthem is blocked, so closing this one value leaf makes the whole card writable.
